about: Hand-worked staff totals for each institute's latest staff record with a total, read from the quotation that supports it, never from the export or display.total_staff. The content step checks each chart row's staff total against these entries; an institute whose data carries a staff total with no entry here, or whose latest record no longer matches its entry, fails with its key. Edit with the DATA change that adds or changes such a figure; the reviewer checks each entry against its source.

staff.quote: The headcount of the AI Security Institute is 243, equivalent to 227.8 full time equivalent (FTE) posts (as at 12 October 2026).
The AI Office employs more than 140 staff members, including over 40 in its AI safety unit, the majority of whom have technical profiles, including in cybersecurity.
의원실 자료에 따르면 미국의 관련 인력은 34명으로 향후 80명까지 확대할 계획이다.
국내 평가 역량을 담당할 AI안전연구소의 인력 문제도 제기됐다. 이 의원은 인력이 26명에서 38명으로 늘었지만 해외 주요국보다 부족하다며 확충을 요구했다.
